reasoning: The evidence overwhelmingly indicates that GTA VI's release has been officially delayed from 2025 to May 26, 2026. Multiple sources from October 2025 confirm Rockstar Games announced this delay, citing the need for technical excellence and quality assurance. The question asks if the game will be sold in Europe in 2025. Since the official release date is May 26, 2026, the game will not be available for sale in Europe in 2025. While one source mentions speculation about an October 2026 delay, the consistent official announcement across multiple sources is May 2026. The background information stating a 2025 release was accurate at the time but has been superseded by official announcements in the retrieved evidence.
